abstract.p: This study introduces a concept-based methodology to optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tasks by assessing dataset certainty using entropy-based metrics and concept extraction techniques. Unlike traditional methods focused on reducing LLM hallucinations or modifying data structures, this approach evaluates inherent knowledge uncertainty from an LLM perspective. By pre-processing documents with LLMs, the concept-based method significantly enhances precision in tasks demanding high accuracy, such as legal, finance, or formal document responses.
